question: Does the frozen full-frame plus four-corner tile proposal, target-only FFA and native SAM2 chain localize wholly new physical door 15 at IoU at least 0.5 in all three frozen query views?

predecessor.single_change: Move the sealed fixed-tile target-only FFA chain from consumed D03 to pre-download, pre-RGB, pre-model family 43b8cae9 -> 43b8cae5, target door 15.

proposal.selection: Union unchanged full-frame proposals with fixed overlapping corner-tile proposals; no query truth access.

tiling.merge: Retain up to 16 full-frame and 8 per tile, remap to full-image coordinates, then rank their SAM-masked FFA descriptors together without NMS or truth filtering.

descriptor.feature: SAM-mask-weighted mean of normalized 37x37 DINOv2 patch tokens inside the unmasked RGB box crop, followed by L2 normalization.
descriptor.score: Maximum cosine to the three target FFA memories only; no sibling subtraction, fitted scale or threshold.

masker.contract: Apply unchanged native SAM2 to every retained proposal and use the selected mask tight bbox.

evaluation.truth_role: Provider boxes enter only post-ranking proposal opportunity and tight-mask-box IoU evaluation.

decision_gate.interpretation: All three frames must contain a retained IoU-at-least-0.5 proposal and all three FFA top-one masks must reach IoU at least 0.5.

literature_motivation.use: Direct instance-template FFA matching and SAM refinement.

literature_motivation.source: Multi-scale tiling for pseudo-labeling in dense scene object detection
literature_motivation.use: Fixed overlapping tiles for proposal reachability.

forbidden_after_freeze: change images, tile geometry, proposal prompt/threshold/caps, FFA, memory, SAM or IoU gate
use sibling appearance or provider query boxes to generate, filter, rank or prompt proposals
retry, replace a frame or add any post-outcome rescue on this family
claim_boundary: A pass can establish only narrow same-provider new-family confirmation that the frozen tiled target-only FFA pipeline acquires and localizes one bound physical door from full query frames. Same-provider geometry selected reference boxes. It cannot establish calibrated open-set absence, broad distractor coverage, raw-phone or provider-independent generalization, named entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
